title: Cosmological Vacuum Decays from Schwinger-Keldysh Formalism
summary: In this work, we take a first step to a stochastic real-time description of the vacuum phase transitions in a radiation-dominated FLRW universe from the Schwinger-Keldysh formalism. By splitting the phase transition field $Φ$ into the long-wavelength mode $φ$ and the short-wavelength mode $σ$ and tracing over the latter as the environment, we obtain a classical Langevin-type equation-of-motion for the long-wavelength field $φ$, where the quantum effects are encoded in a non-Markov memory kernel and a non-Gaussian noise.
